description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gurulupitigama, Giribawa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420968 (28/1032)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of title determinations for numerous land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, and property characteristics, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
